sessionFieldGuide.participantAlias: P01 through P04; never an account identifier
sessionFieldGuide.consentGiven: boolean; do not add a session without consent
sessionFieldGuide.deviceClasses: desktop, tablet or physical_phone; distinguish physical devices from emulation
sessionFieldGuide.browserFamily: family only; no user-agent or device identifier
sessionFieldGuide.taskResults: task code, attempted/succeeded/failed/skipped, elapsed seconds, non-sensitive issue category
sessionFieldGuide.roleReview: reviewed count, seriously-consider yes/no/unknown counts, eligibility/timing unknown counts, confirmed contradiction categories
sessionFieldGuide.missedRoles: present/outside_coverage/requirement_excluded/details_unknown/plausible_monitored_source_miss counts; public URLs only with permission
sessionFieldGuide.timeComparison: condition order, usual/app elapsed seconds, qualifying-role counts, time-cap flags
sessionFieldGuide.easeRating: integer 1 through 5, or null if skipped
sessionFieldGuide.optionalFeedback: brief voluntary non-sensitive text; omit notes, resumes and application history

limitations: No humans have been recruited, observed or counted.
Local password-account automation does not establish Google OAuth or human account-switch behavior.
A mobile viewport is not a second physical device.
No participant usefulness, whole-market recall, time-saving or retention claim is established.
